title: Warring Reactor
description: Adds a reactor - a smart turret ready for combat.
body:
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f308997d4f939040fddee42d260e6138935fcb1b.png)

**This mod adds a new combat block to your game called the Reactor. It's not activated by default, but if you activate it with a special golden key, it will turn on!**

It will attack nearby creatures within its radius, prioritizing aggressive creatures and those closest to it. However, it has a 15-second cooldown after 12 seconds of use and requires fuel (coal or lava).

It can also be upgraded with diamonds to level 2, and then to levels 3 and 4 with improved stats.
The block does NOT attack tamed animals or peasants. The mod also includes two achievements.

The block can attack through walls, at level 1 it deals 3 damage, and if several blocks attack a target at the same time, the damage will be greater.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25bced771ad48062b7941b256ccd8dc3ed884ddd.png)

Note:

To upgrade to level 2, you need: 1 diamond.

To upgrade to level 3, you need: 1 diamond block.

To upgrade to level 4, you need: 1 netherite ingot.
